subject: dist/index.html has two <link rel=manifest> (static one + vite-plugin-pwa's injected one)
body: The built index.html carries both '<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest" />' (apps/web/index.html) and the one vite-plugin-pwa injects. Please keep one (drop the static tag, or set the plugin's injectManifest/manifest link injection off). S22's lighthouse.spec.ts (E2E_LIGHTHOUSE=1, CI job 'lighthouse') asserts exactly one manifest link, installabilityErrors empty, manifest name/short_name/start_url/display/theme_color/background_color/icons 192+512, SW controlling, offline reload renders. Local results on the current tip (iPad 820x1180 DPR2, Slow 4G, 4x CPU): a11y 100, best practices 100, Today TTI 1.55 s; performance 0.82-0.87 until the lazy-load changes land.
